Callout.Name: Document Forgery - Print Shop
Callout.Message: Forged documents being produced at a print shop.

Script.Line: We print invitations and business cards. Look at the sign.
The laminator runs all day. That is what a laminator does.
The back room is stock. It is only stock.

Lines.Approach: The shop is open and the laminator is going. Ask to see the licence and watch the back room.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
